name: Altar
overview: The altar in Scripture is portrayed as a sacred place of encounter with God, where faithful worshipers offer sacrifices and call upon the Lord’s name. From Noah’s first altar after the flood to Abraham’s altars marking God’s promises, these structures signify devotion and obedience, as seen when Abraham prepared an altar for Isaac in obedience to God’s command. The altar is central to expressing covenant relationship and trust in God’s provision and guidance.
